limitations: CPU reference transaction only; no GPU, PCIe, NVLink, RDMA, NIC, FPGA, or DPU was exercised.
Dynamic ordering instrumentation proves the exercised resume_checkpoint call order, not all possible distributed executions.
The post-prepare probe covers validation failure, durable rollback, cleanup, and retry; it does not cover every import, rollback-cleanup, process-crash, or post-ownership-commit failure point.
The aggregate deadline bounds caller waiting, but a timed-out daemon worker can continue its in-flight task until that task returns.
The run_trial stale-source probe exercises source fencing; gateway stale-epoch rejection is covered by focused gateway tests, not the raw trial field.
The bounded Rust model checker explores its declared finite state space and is not a universal proof.
The 87.5% transfer reduction is content-addressed local-file software reuse over reference fixture state, not a measured GPU or network multicast result.
